title: Designing a new fast solution to control isolation rooms in hospitals depending on artificial intelligence decision.
summary: Full Methods and Results describe an MLP trained on 45 hospital cases (31 train, 7 validation, 7 test) using time, cost, facility and space inputs to choose prefabricated isolation units versus retrofit. Reported 43% time reduction/78% lower average cost is tied to described implementation comparison at 45 hospitals, though measurement and external comparator details are limited; preserve that scope. The paper appeared in Biomedical Signal Processing and Control. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
